correctness.rationale: Two source-complete, finite exhaustive programs prove minimal monitoring cardinality eight (zero of the 77,520 seven-sets and exactly 25 of the 125,970 eight-sets); the monitoring predicate is equivalent to full union of pairwise edge-deletion witness masks. A second checker counts all shortest paths rather than using edge deletions, independently obtains the same 25-state intersection profile, and checks an explicit graph isomorphism. Every 3-exchange adjacency and eccentricity is enumerated, so the doubled complete multigraph incidence classification and sharp 3-sensor threshold have a verified finite proof. No sampled or asymptotic inference is used.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral graph is a canonical cubic polyhedral network, the precise minimum edge-failure monitor family is a natural algorithmic object, and the first reconfiguration threshold at three simultaneous probes is meaningful for retaining optimal network coverage throughout migration. The complete doubled-K5 incidence structure provides exact connectivity, degrees, radius and diameter and is not a mere substitution or arbitrary parameter slice. The result is limited to a finite graph, but a complete and nontrivial natural classification is valuable without an infinite-family theorem.
